name: demon step
author: elemelon
description: Don’t click the second blue orb at 47% to move to the ceiling as the ball. Time a click to fall between the blocks at 50% and hit the front of the yellow pad, click the yellow orb to make it to the second pillar and then click on the edge of the block under the blue orb at 51% to move back to the ceiling. Move down at 54% and then back up to the ceiling at 55%. Click to move down from the ceiling and enter the UFO portal as mini at 57%. Play through the following section as mini until 61% where you need to go under the cube portal by straighflying between the top of the spike and cube portal. Navigate through the following section as the ship until 66% where you can move to the ceiling. Stay at the ceiling until the end from there.
